chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Hashimi narrated to us, saying: Furat ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, saying: Ubayd ibn Kathir narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Marwan narrated to us, saying: Ubayd ibn Yahya ibn Mihran al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, from his father, from his grandfather, saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not the path of those upon whom is the anger, nor those who are mislead.'

He said: The Shi'a of Ali (peace be upon him) are those upon whom You have bestowed favor with the Wilayah (Divine Authority) of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him). He was not angry at them, nor did He mislead them.

key_terms.الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ: Those upon whom is the anger

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Shi'a of Ali' mentioned in the interpretation of Surah Al-Fatiha?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* via a chain tracing back to Imam al-Husayn, this hadith offers a specific Shia exegetical interpretation of Surah Al-Fatiha, equating 'those upon whom You have bestowed favor' with the Shi'a of Ali through the lens of Wilayah. It establishes a theological guarantee that adherence to Ali’s authority ensures exemption from divine anger and misguidance, a concept deeply rooted in Shia discussions on the infallibility and spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.basel-kadem: 8.	We were told by Hasan bin Muhammed bin Sa’eed al-Hashimi, that he said: We were told by Furat bin Ibrahim, that he said: We were told by Ubaid bin Kathir, that he said: I was told by Muhammed bin Marwan, that he said: We were told by Ubaid bin Yahya bin Mahran al-‘Attar, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hussain, from his father, from his grandfather, that he said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «The Path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not the path of those upon whom is the anger, nor those who are mislead.» [1:7]
He said: The Shi’a of Ali, peace be upon him, upon whom You have bestowed with the Divine Authority of Ali bin Abi Talib, peace be upon him. He was not angry at them, nor did were they mislead.
